C289.story: A 1954 five-centavo coin from Argentina, from Juan Perón's second presidency. The side shown has a large 5 with CENTAVOS and the date, and REPUBLICA ARGENTINA around the rim; the other side of this series carries a portrait of José de San Martín, the general who led Argentina to independence.
